image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a rusty, vintage agricultural plow resting in tall green grass. The image focuses on the lower section of the implement, showing a curved metal share and part of the frame structure. A large, rusted wheel rim is visible in the bottom left foreground. The background consists of unkempt grass and a small bush.
